# mooncake history show

Show one historical run by index

## Description

Index is 1-based newest-first. `history show 1` is identical to bare `history`.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
